command:
set -eu
[ "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 15e107d8-0ed1-4e5e-83d8-b27c8a49d853 ]
[ "$(cat /sys/block/mmcblk0/device/cid)" = 275048534436344760702d33e0017c00 ]
flock -n -x /run/fes-de25-computer.lock sh -c 'set -eu
grep -q '"'"'^DE25_SHARED_LIFECYCLE_PASS final_held=true owned_overlay_retained=true$'"'"' /tmp/fes-de25-shared-lifecycle-1cf/run.log
[ "$(cat /sys/kernel/config/device-tree/overlays/fes-runtime/status)" = applied ]
[ "$(sha256sum /lib/firmware/fes-runtime-core.rbf | cut -d '"'"' '"'"' -f1)" = 63eebb5f53f4254a4beaab3bfe1a3d695d3da20d71e4f8f445bab816e28fa5db ]
rmdir /sys/kernel/config/device-tree/overlays/fes-runtime
[ ! -d /sys/kernel/config/device-tree/overlays/fes-runtime ]
rm /lib/firmware/fes-runtime-core.rbf
umount /sys/kernel/config
rm -rf -- /tmp/fes-de25-shared-lifecycle-1cf
[ ! -e /tmp/fes-de25-shared-lifecycle-1cf ]
[ ! -e /lib/firmware/fes-runtime-core.rbf ]
sha256sum /sys/kernel/notes /usr/share/fes/kernel-modules.json
ls -ln /dev/fes-de25-scanout
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo SHARED_LIFECYCLE_SUCCESS_CLEANUP_PASS
'
